fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM178,060. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0005635/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Minimum FIVE (5) C including THREE (3) from Biology, Physics, Chemistry, or Mathematics at SPM/O-levels and at least a credit in English AND 2.50 CGPA at STPM level in the Science Stream; Minimum THREE (3) D at A-level including any THREE (3) from Biology, Physics, Chemistry, or Mathematics; Foundation in science with 2.50 CGPA including any THREE (3) from Biology, Physics, Chemistry, or Mathematics; Diploma in a science-based field with 2.75 CGPA.
